Subject: QuickScale trial — PO or alternative?

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — QuickScale is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. Procurement asked whether we need a formal purchase order to start the 90-day trial, or if you can accept invoices without a PO for pilots. We're ready to sign the SOW (attached) but our internal PO process is slow and likely to delay kickoff by a few weeks.

Attaching the SOW for reference.

Hi Jared — thanks for sending the SOW and for the great conversation. Short answer: our standard policy requires a PO for any vendor onboarding, but we have an "invoice-only" temporary path for low-risk pilots that meet certain criteria.

To evaluate a temporary exception we need:
- Completed PO exemption request form (one page)
- Evidence of company billing details (W-9 / tax id)
- Point of contact in finance who will accept invoices
- Expected spend cap during pilot (max amount)

If QuickScale can submit the PO_exemption_request_form.docx (attached filled), and confirm a cap (<= $5k preferred for auto-approval, $5–10k requires ops sign-off), procurement can usually approve a 90-day invoice-only trial. Priyom, Marissa — looping you in to confirm current thresholds and any additional evidence we should request.

Jared — happy to fast-track this if you can get the form & W-9 back today.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_exemption_request_form.docx (23KB, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuickScale trial — PO or alternative?

Ava / Marissa — quick internal note on thresholds:
- Invoice-only auto-approval: pilot spend <= $5,000 and vendor in low-risk tier (no data residency concerns, public company or standard corporate profile)
- Ops approval required: $5,001–$10,000 or vendor requests special T&Cs
- Anything > $10,000 needs normal PO + procurement review.

For QuickScale (startup but with SS&C financing, appears to have standard paperwork on file), if they return the exemption form + W-9 and confirm a hard cap of $5k we can approve a 90-day invoice-only path. I'll prepare a short authorization email they can attach to invoices. Also recommend collecting a short statement about data handling (just a 1-paragraph confirmation) for audit trail.

I'll draft the approval language and share internally; Ava, once Jared returns the docs I'll send the formal authorization.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Jared Mills <jared@quickscale.com>, Elena Soto <elena@quickscale.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: 90-day QuickScale trial on invoice-only path (cap $5,000)

Hi Jared / Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the form and W-9. Procurement reviewed the submission and approved a temporary invoice-only onboarding for the 90-day trial under the following conditions:

- Firm spend cap of $5,000 for the entire trial period (no invoicing beyond cap)
- QuickScale confirms in writing that no customer data will be retained beyond what is necessary to run the demo (one-paragraph data handling statement attached in email body)
- QuickScale invoices should be sent to billing@redwood.com with reference QS-2026-042 and include the signed authorization email we provided below
- Approval is timeboxed to 90 days from kickoff; any extension requires a PO or renewed approval from procurement

Authorization (for invoice attachment):
"Redwood Inference authorizes QuickScale Inc to proceed under an invoice-only pilot for up to $5,000 (deal QS-2026-042). This temporary exception is valid for 90 days from the pilot start date and does not waive the requirement for a PO for future engagements."

A couple of next steps:
- Please confirm the pilot start date (we'll need it for the 90-day clock).
- Email the W-9 and signed SOW to billing@redwood.com and include this authorization language.

Looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
